items.title: Xavier Worthy: Exits Sunday's game
items.text:
Worthy left Sunday's game against the Jets with an apparent leg injury, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jake Ferguson: Suffers knee injury in Week 9
items.text:
Ferguson sustained a knee injury during Sunday's game against the Colts, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports.

items.title: KC Concepcion: Returns to Sunday's game
items.text:
Concepcion returned to Sunday's game against the Saints after previously appearing to injure his right leg, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Gets 18 touches in return
items.text:
Hall (quadriceps) rushed 15 times for 61 yards and caught three of four targets for 26 yards in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
